# Ghost

Internal ID: Ghost | Faction: Undead | Main biome: Black Forest | Drops: Ectoplasm, ,, Ghost trophy | Abilities: Attack | Trophy: Ghost trophy | Weak to (x1.5): Spirit | Neutral to (x1): Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Stagger | Resistant to (x0.5): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Stagger limit: 50%

# Introduction

Ghosts are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests within Burial Chambers, and as part of "You feel a chill down your spine..." raid event.

## Drops

• Item: Ectoplasm | 0 Star: 1-2

• Item: Ghost trophy | 0 Star: 10%

### Spawning

• Type: Uncommon spawn point in Burial Chambers | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: During "You feel a chill down your spine..." event after defeating Bonemass | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

• Type: Uncommon spawn point in Smouldering Tombs | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes (only 1-star)

### Attack

Swings their hand sideways in a 1.7-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (25 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

## Notes

• Like Leviathans, they do not respawn, making them a finite creature when raids are disabled.
